positions.name: Applied Digital Corporation
positions.catalyst: After Wednesday's close APLD reported fiscal Q1 FY27: adjusted revenue $300.4M vs ~$132M consensus (+127% beat) and adj. EPS -$0.01 vs -$0.30 expected; SA attributes the move to +322% y/y revenue, strong EBITDA and hyperscaler/AI-factory contracts.
positions.driver: Only +2.6% pre-market ($24.42 vs $23.81 close) on a blowout print; stock sits in the lower third of its 52-week range ($19.01-$50.73) after a ~50% drawdown from the May high, basing $23-29 since August — room for a re-rate/short-covering day. Stop under the late-Sep/early-Oct $23.39-23.59 lows.
positions.risks: Beat is largely lumpy tenant fit-out revenue rather than recurring lease revenue, so the market may fade it; very high beta in a soft tape (futures lower on Iran-diplomacy doubts and rising Treasury yields); possible equity/debt raise to fund build-outs; wide pre-market spread.
